caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wall clock with a prominent black frame adorned with colorful decorative elements, including red, green, blue, and white embellishments resembling flowers and gemstones. The clock face is circular with black Roman numerals and ornate gold detailing at its corners. Two black hands are present on the clock face, indicating the time as approximately 10:10. The lower half of the clock has a rectangular panel featuring an intricate pattern of gold scrollwork surrounding an oval medallion with a radial design in shades of green, red, orange, and white, bordered by a striped motif. The clock is rendered to show depth and shadow, making the frame appear three-dimensional against a plain, light beige background. The details and decorations on the clock frame are symmetrical and enclosed within gold-painted lines that outline the edges.
title: J.C. Brown Clock
